RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the successful candidate are men, making an unlawful sex discrimination claim unviable. While an all-male panel may reflect broader institutional diversity shortcomings or a cultural "old boys' club," it does not evidence discrimination against you based on your sex. Raising gender in this situation will undermine your credibility and distract from genuine issues.

Instead, focus on objective merit and procedural fairness. You hold a master’s degree in educational leadership and five years of deputy principal experience, whereas the appointed candidate lacks formal administrative leadership roles. Send a polite follow-up requesting the written explanation, focusing strictly on comparative qualifications, scoring rubrics, and selection criteria.
